standards.summaryText: Express ideas and develop understanding: talk with others and experience a variety of oral, print and other media texts to explore, develop and justify own opinions and points of view; explore and explain how interactions with others and with oral, print and other media texts affect personal understandings; extend understanding by taking different points of view when rereading and reflecting on oral, print and other media texts
standards.officialOutcomeText: Express ideas and develop understanding: talk with others and experience a variety of oral, print and other media texts to explore, develop and justify own opinions and points of view; explore and explain how interactions with others and with oral, print and other media texts affect personal understandings; extend understanding by taking different points of view when rereading and reflecting on oral, print and other media texts
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to express ideas and develop understanding.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 1 > 1.1 Discover and Explore > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Experiment with language and forms: develop and extend understanding by expressing and responding to ideas on the same topic, in a variety of forms of oral, print and other media texts
standards.officialOutcomeText: Experiment with language and forms: develop and extend understanding by expressing and responding to ideas on the same topic, in a variety of forms of oral, print and other media texts
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to experiment with language and forms.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 1 > 1.1 Discover and Explore > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Express preferences: explain preferences for texts and genres by particular writers, artists, storytellers and filmmakers
standards.officialOutcomeText: Express preferences: explain preferences for texts and genres by particular writers, artists, storytellers and filmmakers
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to express preferences.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 1 > 1.1 Discover and Explore > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Set goals: reflect on own growth in language learning and use, by considering progress over time and the attainment of personal goals
standards.officialOutcomeText: Set goals: reflect on own growth in language learning and use, by considering progress over time and the attainment of personal goals
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to set goals.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 1 > 1.1 Discover and Explore > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Consider the ideas of others: integrate own perspectives and interpretations with new understandings developed through discussing and through experiencing a variety of oral, print and other media texts
standards.officialOutcomeText: Consider the ideas of others: integrate own perspectives and interpretations with new understandings developed through discussing and through experiencing a variety of oral, print and other media texts
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to consider the ideas of others.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 1 > 1.2 Clarify and Extend > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Combine ideas: examine and re-examine ideas, information and experiences from different points of view to find patterns and see relationships
standards.officialOutcomeText: Combine ideas: examine and re-examine ideas, information and experiences from different points of view to find patterns and see relationships
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to combine ideas.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 1 > 1.2 Clarify and Extend > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Extend understanding: assess whether new information extends understanding by considering diverse opinions and exploring ambiguities
standards.officialOutcomeText: Extend understanding: assess whether new information extends understanding by considering diverse opinions and exploring ambiguities
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to extend understanding.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 1 > 1.2 Clarify and Extend > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Use prior knowledge: discuss how interpretations of the same text might vary, according to the prior knowledge and experiences of various readers; use previous reading experiences, personal experiences and prior knowledge as a basis for reflecting on and interpreting ideas encountered in texts
standards.officialOutcomeText: Use prior knowledge: discuss how interpretations of the same text might vary, according to the prior knowledge and experiences of various readers; use previous reading experiences, personal experiences and prior knowledge as a basis for reflecting on and interpreting ideas encountered in texts
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to use prior knowledge.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 2 > 2.1 Use Strategies and Cues > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Use comprehension strategies: identify explicit and implicit ideas and information in texts; listen and respond to various interpretations of the same text; select appropriate reading rate and strategies for comprehending texts less closely connected to prior knowledge and personal experiences; preview complex texts as to their intent, content and structure, and use this information to set a purpose and select strategies for reading
standards.officialOutcomeText: Use comprehension strategies: identify explicit and implicit ideas and information in texts; listen and respond to various interpretations of the same text; select appropriate reading rate and strategies for comprehending texts less closely connected to prior knowledge and personal experiences; preview complex texts as to their intent, content and structure, and use this information to set a purpose and select strategies for reading
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to use comprehension strategies.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 2 > 2.1 Use Strategies and Cues > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Use textual cues: use knowledge of visual and textual cues and structural features when skimming and scanning various print and other media texts to locate relevant information effectively and efficiently; analyze and discuss how the structural features of informational materials, such as textbooks, bibliographies, databases, catalogues, web sites, commercials and newscasts, enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of communication
standards.officialOutcomeText: Use textual cues: use knowledge of visual and textual cues and structural features when skimming and scanning various print and other media texts to locate relevant information effectively and efficiently; analyze and discuss how the structural features of informational materials, such as textbooks, bibliographies, databases, catalogues, web sites, commercials and newscasts, enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of communication
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to use textual cues.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 2 > 2.1 Use Strategies and Cues > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Use phonics and structural analysis: apply and explain effective procedures for identifying and comprehending words in context; adjust procedures according to the purpose for reading and the complexity of the texts
standards.officialOutcomeText: Use phonics and structural analysis: apply and explain effective procedures for identifying and comprehending words in context; adjust procedures according to the purpose for reading and the complexity of the texts
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to use phonics and structural analysis.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 2 > 2.1 Use Strategies and Cues > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Use references: use reference materials, including a writer's handbook, to verify correct usage, address uncertainties and solve problems that arise
standards.officialOutcomeText: Use references: use reference materials, including a writer's handbook, to verify correct usage, address uncertainties and solve problems that arise
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to use references.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 2 > 2.1 Use Strategies and Cues > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Experience various texts: experience oral, print and other media texts from a variety of cultural traditions and genres, such as essays, broadcast advertisements, novels, poetry, documentaries, films, electronic magazines and realistic fiction; identify and discuss how timeless themes are developed in a variety of oral, print and other media texts; consider historical context when developing own points of view or interpretations of oral, print and other media texts; compare and contrast own life situation with themes of oral, print and other media texts; express the themes of oral, print or other media texts in different forms or genres; consider peers' interpretations of oral, print and other media texts, referring to the texts for supporting or contradicting evidence
standards.officialOutcomeText: Experience various texts: experience oral, print and other media texts from a variety of cultural traditions and genres, such as essays, broadcast advertisements, novels, poetry, documentaries, films, electronic magazines and realistic fiction; identify and discuss how timeless themes are developed in a variety of oral, print and other media texts; consider historical context when developing own points of view or interpretations of oral, print and other media texts; compare and contrast own life situation with themes of oral, print and other media texts; express the themes of oral, print or other media texts in different forms or genres; consider peers' interpretations of oral, print and other media texts, referring to the texts for supporting or contradicting evidence
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to experience various texts.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 2 > 2.2 Respond to Texts > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Construct meaning from texts: analyze how the choices and motives of characters portrayed in oral, print and other media texts provide insight into those of self and others; identify and discuss theme and point of view in oral, print and other media texts; discuss and explain various interpretations of the same oral, print or other media text; relate the themes, emotions and experiences portrayed in oral, print and other media texts to issues of personal interest or significance
standards.officialOutcomeText: Construct meaning from texts: analyze how the choices and motives of characters portrayed in oral, print and other media texts provide insight into those of self and others; identify and discuss theme and point of view in oral, print and other media texts; discuss and explain various interpretations of the same oral, print or other media text; relate the themes, emotions and experiences portrayed in oral, print and other media texts to issues of personal interest or significance
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to construct meaning from texts.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 2 > 2.2 Respond to Texts > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Appreciate the artistry of texts: discuss how techniques, such as irony, symbolism, perspective and proportion, communicate meaning and enhance effect in oral, print and other media texts; discuss character development in terms of consistency of behaviour and plausibility of change; describe how theme, dominant impression and mood are developed and sustained through choices in language use and the interrelationship of plot, setting and character; identify features that define particular oral, print and other media texts; discuss differences in style and their effects on content and audience impression
standards.officialOutcomeText: Appreciate the artistry of texts: discuss how techniques, such as irony, symbolism, perspective and proportion, communicate meaning and enhance effect in oral, print and other media texts; discuss character development in terms of consistency of behaviour and plausibility of change; describe how theme, dominant impression and mood are developed and sustained through choices in language use and the interrelationship of plot, setting and character; identify features that define particular oral, print and other media texts; discuss differences in style and their effects on content and audience impression
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to appreciate the artistry of texts.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 2 > 2.2 Respond to Texts > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Understand forms and genres: explain the relationships between purposes and characteristics of various forms and genres of oral, print and other media texts; evaluate the effectiveness of different types of media texts for presenting ideas and information
standards.officialOutcomeText: Understand forms and genres: explain the relationships between purposes and characteristics of various forms and genres of oral, print and other media texts; evaluate the effectiveness of different types of media texts for presenting ideas and information
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to understand forms and genres.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA9 > General Outcome 2 > 2.3 Understand Forms, Elements and Techniques > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Understand techniques and elements: compare the development of character, plot and theme in two oral, print or other media texts; evaluate the effectiveness of oral, print and other media texts, considering the believability of plot and setting, the credibility of characters, and the development and resolution of conflict; compare a main character in one text to the main character in another text from a different era, genre or medium; identify ways that a change in narrator might affect the overall meaning of oral, print and other media texts; summarize the content of media texts, and suggest alternative treatments
standards.officialOutcomeText: Understand techniques and elements: compare the development of character, plot and theme in two oral, print or other media texts; evaluate the effectiveness of oral, print and other media texts, considering the believability of plot and setting, the credibility of characters, and the development and resolution of conflict; compare a main character in one text to the main character in another text from a different era, genre or medium; identify ways that a change in narrator might affect the overall meaning of oral, print and other media texts; summarize the content of media texts, and suggest alternative treatments
